cohort: 20 women diagnosed with AFE from five tertiary university-affiliated medical centers in Israel between 2005 and 2015
finding: Amniotic fluid embolism is associated with significant maternal morbidity and mortality, with a 15% mortality rate and another 15% suffering major neurological disability.
mod_finding: 70% of AFE cases presented during vaginal delivery, 20% during cesarean delivery, and 10% during dilation and evacuation.
